trajectory.prompt: Create /workspace/csv.js: a Node ESM module exporting parseCsv(text) that parses CSV per RFC 4180 into an array of rows (arrays of string fields). Requirements: fields may be wrapped in double quotes; a quoted field keeps commas and newlines literally; a doubled quote ("") inside a quoted field is one literal quote; both \n and \r\n end records; an empty field is the empty string, including trailing empty fields. Also add /workspace/package.json with "type": "module". Reply "done" when written.
